description: Ordered navigation helper that reveals hierarchy and current location without turning decorative separators into targets.

usageNotes: Use for previous hierarchy levels that users may revisit.
Ancestor items may be rendered without href only when the source route is intentionally unavailable.
Always reserve the final breadcrumb item for the current page.
Do not style the current item like a normal navigation target.
Use only when constrained width forces the middle of the path to collapse.
The summary preserves path meaning but is not a dropdown trigger in v1.

separator.announcedBehavior: Decorative sequence marker that should not become a primary navigation target

notes: Prefer showing the first item, a collapsed summary, and the final two visible items when the path exceeds the configured threshold.
Single-step paths remain valid and should render without redundant decoration.

misusePatterns: rendering the current page as an ordinary link
turning the collapsed summary into a dropdown trigger in the base contract
